responsibility: Implements the TILEPro target’s C-family preprocessor builtins hook, TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS. It defines the architecture-identification macros and assertions seen by source code, advertises the availability of sync compare-and-swap builtins for 1/2/4/8-byte sizes, and delegates to the target endianness and GNU user OS builtin helpers, making this file the C front-end interface layer for TILEPro-specific predefined macros rather than code generation logic.
